description: The figure presents four pie charts showing the distribution of language model answer refusal categories for GPT4-o, Gemini1.5-Pro, Llama3.1-70B-Instruct, and Llama3.1-405B-Instruct. The GPT4-o chart contains 2 slices: “Lack of Knowledge” in dark red at 5 (83.3%) and “Safety” in light orange at 1 (16.7%), with percentage and count labels inside the slices and no visible legend. The Gemini1.5-Pro chart contains 5 slices with internal labels: “Misinformation” in orange at 33 (38.4%), “Lack of Knowledge” in dark blue at 19 (22.1%), “Ethical Advice” in light blue at 14 (16.3%), “Clarification” in pale yellow at 12 (14.0%), and “Safety” in red at 8 (9.3%), with no slice offset and no legend. The Llama3.1-70B-Instruct chart contains 2 slices: “Lack of Knowledge” in orange at 3 (75.0%) and “Clarification” in red at 1 (25.0%), labeled inside the slices. The Llama3.1-405B-Instruct chart contains 2 equal halves labeled inside: “Lack of Knowledge” in orange at 2 (50.0%) and “Misinformation” in red at 2 (50.0%); across all charts, slices are not exploded or otherwise visually emphasized beyond color and internal text, and the ordering appears to follow slice size in some cases but is not consistently uniform across panels.
